## Callouts and conventions

::: {.tldr custom-style="tldr"}
Fenced divs mark callouts, and the build adds each callout's label for every format.
:::

The build adds the label and icon to each callout, so writers never type them.

::: {.pro-tip custom-style="pro-tip"}
Keep callouts short. A callout that runs longer than the surrounding prose is a section in disguise.
:::

::: {.for-managers custom-style="for-managers"}
Guidance aimed at people managers goes here.
:::

::: {.for-ics custom-style="for-ics"}
Guidance aimed at individual contributors goes here.
:::

::: {.common-objection custom-style="common-objection"}
**"Do I have to use callouts?"** No. Use them where they help a reader skim.
:::
